# Category selection scope excludes Save persistence

For Bug 2084433 at revision 24ae8c26d87e424b3f98e49153604460e4ede65b, the implementation report assigns category loading and selection to the editable draft. Category persistence belongs to Bug 2062008. A CodeRabbit request to add persistence was withdrawn as outside scope. This is a recorded task boundary, not evidence that category persistence is generally unnecessary. The report says the patch remained unstaged.

Scope: Calendar event categories.
